cues.text: Bigger welcome! Hello, San Francisco!

cues.zh: 熱烈歡迎 ！你們好，舊金山 ！

cues.text: TEDx – oh my God, blinding light!
cues.en: TEDx – oh my God, blinding light!
cues.zh: TEDx — — 噢我的天啊，燈光好亮 ！

cues.text: Hi, everybody! How are you?
cues.en: Hi, everybody! How are you?
cues.zh: 嗨，大家好嗎？

cues.text: (Audience cheering) Fine?! Oh my gosh! Okay, so...
cues.en: (Audience cheering) Fine?! Oh my gosh! Okay, so...
cues.zh: (觀眾歡呼) 挺好？ ！ 哦我的天啊 ！好，那麼......

cues.text: My name is Mel Robbins, and for the last seventeen years,
cues.en: My name is Mel Robbins, and for the last seventeen years,
cues.zh: 我的名字是梅爾羅賓斯， 在過去的十七年中，

cues.text: I have done nothing but help people get everything that they want.
cues.en: I have done nothing but help people get everything that they want.
cues.zh: 我什麼都沒做，除了幫助人們 得到他們想要的一切。

cues.text: Within reason! My husband's here.
cues.en: Within reason! My husband's here.
cues.zh: 合理範圍內啦！我老公在場耶！

cues.text: So, I've done it in the courtroom, in the boardroom, in the bedroom,
cues.en: So, I've done it in the courtroom, in the boardroom, in the bedroom,
cues.zh: 所以，我在法庭上、 會議室裡、臥室裡、

cues.text: in people's living room, whatever room you want to be in,
cues.en: in people's living room, whatever room you want to be in,
cues.zh: 在人們的客廳裡， 不管你想在哪個房間，

cues.text: if I'm there, I will help you get whatever you want by any means necessary.
cues.en: if I'm there, I will help you get whatever you want by any means necessary.
cues.zh: 如果我在，我會不擇手段 幫助你得到任何你想要的，

cues.text: For the last three years – I host a syndicated radio show.
cues.en: For the last three years – I host a syndicated radio show.
cues.zh: 過去的三年，我主持一個 聯網播放的電臺節目。

cues.text: Five days a week, I go live in forty cities
cues.en: Five days a week, I go live in forty cities
cues.zh: 每週 5 天，我在 40 個城市現場直播，

cues.text: and I talk to men and women across America who feel stuck.
cues.en: and I talk to men and women across America who feel stuck.
cues.zh: 與美國各地感覺被困住的人們談話。

cues.text: Do you know that a third of Americans feel dissatisfied with their lives right now?
cues.en: Do you know that a third of Americans feel dissatisfied with their lives right now?
cues.zh: 你知道在這一刻，有三分之一的美國人 對他們的生活感到不滿嗎?

cues.text: That is a hundred million people!
cues.en: That is a hundred million people!
cues.zh: 那是 1 億人啊！

cues.text: That's insane!
cues.en: That's insane!
cues.zh: 簡直是瘋了 ！

cues.text: And I've come face to face with it in this new show that I'm doing,
cues.en: And I've come face to face with it in this new show that I'm doing,
cues.zh: 我在我正在做的一個新節目 裡面對面看到它了，

cues.text: which is also insane, it's called "In-laws".
cues.en: which is also insane, it's called "In-laws".
cues.zh: 也是瘋了。這個節目叫"親家"。

cues.text: I move in with families across America – (Laughter)
cues.en: I move in with families across America – (Laughter)
cues.zh: 我去美國各地的家庭和他們同住 — — （笑聲）

cues.text: You guessed it!
cues.en: You guessed it!
cues.zh: 你猜對了 ！

cues.text: – who are at war with their in-laws.
cues.en: – who are at war with their in-laws.
cues.zh: — — 這些家庭正和他們的親家在對抗呢。

cues.text: We move them into the same house, I verbally assassinate everybody,
cues.en: We move them into the same house, I verbally assassinate everybody,
cues.zh: 我們讓他們全都住到同一屋簷下， 我對每個人講話都很機車，

cues.text: we open up Pandora's box,
cues.en: we open up Pandora's box,
cues.zh: 我們會開啟潘多拉的盒子，

cues.text: and I get people to stop arguing about the donuts
cues.en: and I get people to stop arguing about the donuts
cues.zh: 我會讓他們別為甜甜圈吵架，

cues.text: and who is hosting Thanksgiving dinner,
cues.en: and who is hosting Thanksgiving dinner,
cues.zh: 或誰來主辦感恩節晚餐，

cues.text: and talk about the real stuff.
cues.en: and talk about the real stuff.
cues.zh: 並談論實質的東西。

cues.text: And that's what I want to talk to you about.
cues.en: And that's what I want to talk to you about.
cues.zh: 這些也是我想要跟你們談的。

cues.text: I'm here for you.
cues.en: I'm here for you.
cues.zh: 我是為你站在這兒的，

cues.text: I'm going to tell you everything I know in less than eighteen minutes
cues.en: I'm going to tell you everything I know in less than eighteen minutes
cues.zh: 我要用不到18 分鐘的時間， 告訴你我知道的一切

cues.text: about how to get what you want.
cues.en: about how to get what you want.
cues.zh: 有關於如何獲得你想要的。

cues.text: So I want you to take a millisecond right now
cues.en: So I want you to take a millisecond right now
cues.zh: 我現在請你花點時間，

cues.text: and think about what you want.
cues.en: and think about what you want.
cues.zh: 想一下你想要什麼。

cues.text: You!
cues.en: You!
cues.zh: 你 ！

cues.text: And I want you to be selfish.
cues.en: And I want you to be selfish.
cues.zh: 我要你自私地去想。

cues.text: Screw Simon and the "We" thing. This is about me, right now!
cues.en: Screw Simon and the "We" thing. This is about me, right now!
cues.zh: 去你的Simon和"我們"。 這是關於我，就現在 ！

cues.text: (Laughter) (Applause) Sorry, Simon.
cues.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Sorry, Simon.
cues.zh: （笑聲）（掌聲）抱歉，Simon。

cues.text: What do you want? And here's the deal.
cues.en: What do you want? And here's the deal.
cues.zh: 你想要什麼？這問題要這樣看，

cues.text: I don't want it to sound good to other people.
cues.en: I don't want it to sound good to other people.
cues.zh: 我不要它聽起來冠冕堂皇。

cues.text: Being healthy will not get your ass on a treadmill.
cues.en: Being healthy will not get your ass on a treadmill.
cues.zh: 光是健康有甚麼動力? 它不會讓你的屁股在跑步機上動起來。

cues.text: Losing your manboobs, so you can hook up with somebody,
cues.en: Losing your manboobs, so you can hook up with somebody,
cues.zh: 把你男性乳房給瘦沒了， 你才能把到妹子，

cues.text: now that's motivation. (Laughter)
cues.en: now that's motivation. (Laughter)
cues.zh: 那才是動力。（笑聲）

cues.text: So, I want to know: What do you want?
cues.en: So, I want to know: What do you want?
cues.zh: 所以，我想知道： 你想要什麼？

cues.text: Do you want to lose weight? Do you want to triple your income?
cues.en: Do you want to lose weight? Do you want to triple your income?
cues.zh: 你想減肥嗎？你想要你收入翻三倍嗎？

cues.text: Do you want to start a nonprofit? Do you want to find love?
cues.en: Do you want to start a nonprofit? Do you want to find love?
cues.zh: 你想要建立一個非營利組織嗎？ 你想要找到真愛嗎？

cues.text: What is it? Get it, right here.
cues.en: What is it? Get it, right here.
cues.zh: 想要什麼？留住它，在這裡（指腦袋）。

cues.text: You know what it is, don't analyze it to death, just pick something.
cues.en: You know what it is, don't analyze it to death, just pick something.
cues.zh: 你知道它是什麼， 別往死裡分析，就選一個。

cues.text: That's part of the problem. You won't pick.
cues.en: That's part of the problem. You won't pick.
cues.zh: 這是問題的一部分。你沒法選擇。

cues.text: So, we're going to be talking about how you get what you want.
cues.en: So, we're going to be talking about how you get what you want.
cues.zh: 所以，我們要談談 你如何得到你想要的。

cues.text: And frankly, getting what you want is simple.
cues.en: And frankly, getting what you want is simple.
cues.zh: 坦白說，得到你想要的，其實很單純。

cues.text: But notice I didn't say it was easy.
cues.en: But notice I didn't say it was easy.
cues.zh: 但注意我沒說它很容易。

cues.text: It's very simple.
cues.en: It's very simple.
cues.zh: 它很單純。

cues.text: In fact, if you think about it,
cues.en: In fact, if you think about it,
cues.zh: 事實上，如果你想一想

cues.text: we live in the most amazing moment in time.
cues.en: we live in the most amazing moment in time.
cues.zh: 我們活在一個最令人驚嘆的時刻。

cues.text: So that thing that you have up here, whatever it may be,
cues.en: So that thing that you have up here, whatever it may be,
cues.zh: 你腦袋裡想的事，不管它是什麼，

cues.text: you want to use healthy eating to cure your diabetes,
cues.en: you want to use healthy eating to cure your diabetes,
cues.zh: 你想要使用健康飲食治好你的糖尿病，

cues.text: you want to figure out how to take care of the elders
cues.en: you want to figure out how to take care of the elders
cues.zh: 你想要知道如何照顧老年人

cues.text: and start a new hospice center,
cues.en: and start a new hospice center,
cues.zh: 並成立一個臨終關懷中心，

cues.text: you want to move to Africa and build a school... Guess what?
cues.en: you want to move to Africa and build a school... Guess what?
cues.zh: 你想要去非洲 建立一所學校...你知道麼？

cues.text: You can walk into a book store – right now! –
cues.en: You can walk into a book store – right now! –
cues.zh: 你可以去一家書店 --現在！--

cues.text: and buy at least ten books written by credentialed experts
cues.en: and buy at least ten books written by credentialed experts
cues.zh: 至少買十本資深專家寫的書，

cues.text: on how the hell you do it.
cues.en: on how the hell you do it.
cues.zh: 他們會告訴你怎麼做。

cues.text: You could Google it.
cues.en: You could Google it.
cues.zh: 你可以谷歌搜尋一下。

cues.text: And you could probably find at least, I don't know - a thousand blogs
cues.en: And you could probably find at least, I don't know - a thousand blogs
cues.zh: 你大概可以找到至少，我不知道 — —

cues.text: documenting the step, by step, by step transformation
cues.en: documenting the step, by step, by step transformation
cues.zh: 一千個部落格，記錄著別人 已經一步一步在做的事情。

cues.text: that somebody else is already doing.
cues.en: that somebody else is already doing.
cues.zh: 你可以在網上找到任何人， 然後在網上跟蹤他們 ！

cues.text: You can find anybody online and cyber-stalk them!
cues.en: You can find anybody online and cyber-stalk them!
cues.zh: 你可以在網上找到任何人， 然後在網上跟蹤他們 ！

cues.text: (Laughter)
cues.en: (Laughter)
cues.zh: （笑聲）

cues.text: You can just walk in their footsteps – just use the science of drafting.
cues.en: You can just walk in their footsteps – just use the science of drafting.
cues.zh: 你可以跟著他們的腳步走， 就像打草稿一樣。

cues.text: Follow what everyone else has done, because somebody is already doing it!
cues.en: Follow what everyone else has done, because somebody is already doing it!
cues.zh: 跟隨其他已經做到的人， 因為別人已經辦到了 ！

cues.text: So why don't you have what you want,
cues.en: So why don't you have what you want,
cues.zh: 所以為什麼你沒有你想要的？

cues.text: when you have all the information that you need,
cues.en: when you have all the information that you need,
cues.zh: 當你有你需要的所有資訊，

cues.text: you have the contacts that you need,
cues.en: you have the contacts that you need,
cues.zh: 你要有需要的門路，

cues.text: there are probably free tools online that allow you to start a business,
cues.en: there are probably free tools online that allow you to start a business,
cues.zh: 搞不好網路上有免費的工具 可以幫助你開創新的事業，

cues.text: or join a group, or do whatever the heck you want!?
cues.en: or join a group, or do whatever the heck you want!?
cues.zh: 或著加入一個團體， 或者做你想要做的任何事情!?

cues.text: It all comes down to one word:
cues.en: It all comes down to one word:
cues.zh: 總結一個字，就是：

cues.text: Shut the front door, you know what I'm talking about?
cues.en: Shut the front door, you know what I'm talking about?
cues.zh: 閉嘴，你知道我說什麼嗎？

cues.text: The f-bomb. It's everywhere!
cues.en: The f-bomb. It's everywhere!
cues.zh: F-炸彈。它無處不在 ！

cues.text: You hear it all the time!
cues.en: You hear it all the time!
cues.zh: 你總是聽到它 ！

cues.text: I honestly don't understand what the appeal is of the word.
cues.en: I honestly don't understand what the appeal is of the word.
cues.zh: 我真心不明白這詞的魅力是什麼。

cues.text: I mean, you don't sound smart when you say it.
cues.en: I mean, you don't sound smart when you say it.
cues.zh: 我是說，你說這詞的時候 聽起來又不聰明。

cues.text: And it's really not expressing how you really feel.
cues.en: And it's really not expressing how you really feel.
cues.zh: 它也不真的表達你真實的感受。

cues.text: It's sort of a cheap shot to take.
cues.en: It's sort of a cheap shot to take.
cues.zh: 它就像便宜的酒。

cues.text: And of course you know I'm talking about the word "fine".
cues.en: And of course you know I'm talking about the word "fine".
cues.zh: 當然你知道我在說這個詞："fine"（很好）。

cues.text: "How you doing?" "Oh, I'm fine."
cues.en: "How you doing?" "Oh, I'm fine."
cues.zh: "你好嗎?哦，我挺好"。

cues.text: Oh, really? You are?
cues.en: Oh, really? You are?
cues.zh: 哦，真的嗎？你是嗎？

cues.text: Dragging around those extra forty pounds, you're fine?
cues.en: Dragging around those extra forty pounds, you're fine?
cues.zh: 拖著那多餘的四十磅，你挺好？

cues.text: Feeling like roommates with your spouse, and you're fine?
cues.en: Feeling like roommates with your spouse, and you're fine?
cues.zh: 與你的配偶感覺像室友，你挺好？

cues.text: You haven't had sex in four months, you're fine?
cues.en: You haven't had sex in four months, you're fine?
cues.zh: 你四個月沒做愛了，你挺好？

cues.text: Really?!
cues.en: Really?!
cues.zh: 真的？ ！

cues.text: I don't think so!
cues.en: I don't think so!
cues.zh: 我不這麼覺得！

cues.text: But see, here's the deal with saying that you're fine: It's actually genius.
cues.en: But see, here's the deal with saying that you're fine: It's actually genius.
cues.zh: 不過，說你挺好的這事兒呢， 其實蠻天才的。

cues.text: Because if you're fine, you don't have to do anything about it.
cues.en: Because if you're fine, you don't have to do anything about it.
cues.zh: 因為如果你挺好， 你不用再做任何改變。

cues.text: But when you think about this word "fine", it just makes me so angry.
cues.en: But when you think about this word "fine", it just makes me so angry.
cues.zh: 但當你思考一下“挺好”這個詞， 它就是讓我很生氣。

cues.text: Here we are at a conference about being alive
cues.en: Here we are at a conference about being alive
cues.zh: 我們在這裡談論有關於活著的議題，

cues.text: and you're going to describe the experience of being alive as "fine"?!
cues.en: and you're going to describe the experience of being alive as "fine"?!
cues.zh: 然後你要描述活著的經驗為"挺好"？ ！

cues.text: What a flimsy and feeble word!
cues.en: What a flimsy and feeble word!
cues.zh: 一個多麼輕薄微弱的詞啊 ！

cues.text: If you're crappy, say you're crappy!
cues.en: If you're crappy, say you're crappy!
cues.zh: 如果你很糟糕，說你很糟糕 ！

cues.text: If you're amazing say you're amazing!
cues.en: If you're amazing say you're amazing!
cues.zh: 如果你很厲害，說你很厲害 ！

cues.text: Tell the truth!
cues.en: Tell the truth!
cues.zh: 說實話 ！

cues.text: And this not only goes for the social construct:
cues.en: And this not only goes for the social construct:
cues.zh: 而這不只是用在社交場合：

cues.text: "Oh, I don't want to burden you with the fact that I hate my life",
cues.en: "Oh, I don't want to burden you with the fact that I hate my life",
cues.zh: "喔，我不想用我討厭我的人生來煩你"，

cues.text: or: "Hey, I'm amazing! But that would make you feel terrible."
cues.en: or: "Hey, I'm amazing! But that would make you feel terrible."
cues.zh: 或者："嘿，我是很厲害 ！ 但這會讓你感覺很糟。”

cues.text: The bigger issue –
cues.en: The bigger issue –
cues.zh: 更大的問題是 — —

cues.text: The bigger issue with "fine" is that you say it to yourself.
cues.en: The bigger issue with "fine" is that you say it to yourself.
cues.zh: "fine"(很好) 最大的問題是 你這麼告訴你自己，

cues.text: That thing that you want, I guarantee you,
cues.en: That thing that you want, I guarantee you,
cues.zh: 那個你想要的東西，我像你保証，

cues.text: you've convinced yourself that you're fine not having it.
cues.en: you've convinced yourself that you're fine not having it.
cues.zh: 你已經說服你自己， 沒有它，也沒關係了。

cues.text: That's why you're not pushing yourself.
cues.en: That's why you're not pushing yourself.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼你不逼迫自己。

cues.text: It's the areas in your life where you've given up.
cues.en: It's the areas in your life where you've given up.
cues.zh: 這就是你在人生中放棄的地方，

cues.text: Where you've said,
cues.en: Where you've said,
cues.zh: 當你說過，

cues.text: "Oh, I'm fine. My mom's never going to change,
cues.en: "Oh, I'm fine. My mom's never going to change,
cues.zh: "哦，我挺好，我媽媽永遠不會改，

cues.text: so I just can't have that conversation."
cues.en: so I just can't have that conversation."
cues.zh: 所以我不能談那個"。

cues.text: "I'm fine. We've got to wait until the kids graduate, before we get divorced,
cues.en: "I'm fine. We've got to wait until the kids graduate, before we get divorced,
cues.zh: "我挺好。我們得等到 孩子們畢業再離婚

cues.text: so we'll just sleep in separate bedrooms."
cues.en: so we'll just sleep in separate bedrooms."
cues.zh: 所以我們就分房睡"。

cues.text: "I'm fine. I lost my job, I can barely pay my bills,
cues.en: "I'm fine. I lost my job, I can barely pay my bills,
cues.zh: "我挺好。我丟了我的工作， 幾乎付不起賬單，

cues.text: but whatever – It's hard to get a job."
cues.en: but whatever – It's hard to get a job."
cues.zh: 但不管了 — — 找到一份工作太難了"。

cues.text: One of the reasons why this word also just annoys me so much is,
cues.en: One of the reasons why this word also just annoys me so much is,
cues.zh: 其中一個原因讓我覺得那個字很煩人是，

cues.text: scientists have calculated –
cues.en: scientists have calculated –
cues.zh: 科學家們已經算出 — —

cues.text: Oh yeah, I'm coming down! (Laughter)
cues.en: Oh yeah, I'm coming down! (Laughter)
cues.zh: 哦耶，我下來了 ！（笑聲）

cues.text: Scientists have calculated
cues.en: Scientists have calculated
cues.zh: 科學家們已經算出

cues.text: the odds
cues.en: the odds
cues.zh: 你們

cues.text: of you
cues.en: of you
cues.zh: 被生下來

cues.text: being born.
cues.en: being born.
cues.zh: 的機率。

cues.text: That's right. They've crunched the numbers. I see you up there.
cues.en: That's right. They've crunched the numbers. I see you up there.
cues.zh: 沒錯。他們已經處理過了... 我看到上邊的你了。

cues.text: They've crunched the numbers on you –
cues.en: They've crunched the numbers on you –
cues.zh: 他們對你的出生機率 已經算出來了，
